name: Horizontal Velocity Response Trial
description: Optional single-aircraft response trial motivated by the October 4 flight: MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC 2.2 instead of the captured 1.8. This candidate is not hardware-validated or automatically applied. Snapshot the actual aircraft values, review the firmware diff, apply grounded, then compare isolated gentle starts, stops, reversals and hover. Keep I/D, MDS shaping and estimator settings fixed; restore the snapshot if oscillation or overshoot increases.
